shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | head -50
cd /workspace; for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/*.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rl "connection()" . | head; echo; grep -rn "no-store" 01-app/01-getting-started/*.md | head -20; ls 01-app/01-getting-started
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; sed -n 1,140p 01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md; grep -n "no-store\|auto no cache\|dynamic" 03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md | head -30
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
